title: First Earth Battalion sergeant kills a goat with his mind, steals a helicopter and disappears
summary: Lyn Buchanan tells of First Earth Battalion sergeant kills a goat with his mind, steals a helicopter and disappears, about unspecified at First Earth Battalion, US Army, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: uh, the guy who did did kill the goat experienced dying with the goat.

plain: A former Army psychic spy named Lyn Buchanan, on Jesse Michels's podcast in 2026, passes on a story he credits to Jim Channon, the Army officer behind the First Earth Battalion, an unusual Army idea about soldiers using mental and spiritual powers. As Buchanan tells it, a sergeant in that group killed a goat using only his mind, felt himself dying along with the goat, and later stole a helicopter and disappeared. If true, it would mean the Army had people who could kill with thought alone.
